name: Sheet Pan Chicken Tikka Masala with Roasted Cauliflower & Red Onion

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince or press the garlic. Set half of the garlic aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine ginger, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, cayenne, and salt, with half of the garlic, and yogurt. Add chicken and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tbsp tomato paste
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp cayenne pepper
1 ½ tsp salt
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a sheet pan. Peel and cut onion into ½-inch pieces; add to the sheet pan with the cauliflower.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Toss cauliflower and onion on the pan with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange in a single layer and place in the oven.  Roast until the cauliflower is fork-tender (about 18-20 minutes).
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the chicken to a sheet pan, spreading the pieces out in a single layer. Place the pan in the oven and roast until cooked through (18- 20minutes).
Meanwhile, combine olive oil, paprika, cumin, salt, and remaining yogurt and garlic in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Once cooked, remove the cauliflower from the oven and toss with fresh parsley.
To serve, arrange the chicken and vegetables on plates, and top chicken with a dollop of yogurt sauce. Enjoy!
